reason: The image shows significant cardiomegaly (enlarged cardiac silhouette) and a right-sided central venous catheter. Additionally, there is blunting of the right costophrenic angle suggestive of a small pleural effusion.
case_description: Frontal chest radiograph displaying an enlarged heart shadow occupying a large portion of the thoracic width. A medical device, specifically a central venous catheter, is visible entering from the right upper chest with its tip projecting over the superior vena cava/right atrial junction. The right lung base shows some opacity and loss of the sharp costophrenic angle.
